text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't modify any tests. The fixes, all in `catalog/`:

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`). It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days instead of multiplying. It now multiplies.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. It now returns the last `n`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the comment above it and the tests say five. It is now 5.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing the "Emma" book. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The tests only check the title, so the author, year and copies are my guess.
